ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a food chain running from left to right. At the far left there is a small shrimp-like organism. An arrow points from it to a small fish, then another arrow points to a larger fish, then to an even larger fish, and finally to a bird on the far right. Reasoning: The lowest or starting point of the food chain is the organism where the arrow sequence begins. Since the sequence starts with the shrimp-like organism, the lowest of the food chain is shrimp.
